title: Payment Calendar of the Handling Month in a HECM Payment Release
content:
**Rule.** Added to the timing adjustment of the payment release on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan moving onto the HECM Line of Credit, Cedarline follows the payment calendar of the handling month:

| Scheduled payments disbursed on the loan | What it means | Timing adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| one disbursed on a date after the same day of the previous month | the handling month is already paid and the first remaining payment is a month away | minus the standard value multiplied by the monthly rate, divided by one plus the monthly rate |
| none in that window, but one disbursed on a date after the same day two months before the handling date | the handling month's payment is still owed | the scheduled payment amount less the standard value multiplied by the monthly rate, divided by one plus the monthly rate |
| neither | — | 0.00 |

The standard value is the value of the remaining payments with the remaining payments counted as twelve times the difference between the tenure age horizon and the borrower's age on a tenure-based plan, and as the term less the scheduled payments already disbursed on a term-based plan; the monthly rate is one twelfth of the sum of the expected rate and the plan's annual premium rate, divided by 100.

**Windows, both sides (hypothetical handling date 15 May).** A payment disbursed on 16 April falls in the one-month window; one disbursed on 15 April does not, but falls in the two-month window, which takes in payments disbursed after 15 March; a payment of 15 March falls in neither.

**Worked figures (hypothetical: standard value 33576.31, monthly rate 5.50 divided by 1200, scheduled payment 500.00).** One month's discount is 33576.31 multiplied by the monthly rate, divided by one plus the monthly rate, about 153.19. In the first case the adjustment is about minus 153.19; in the second, 500.00 less 153.19, about 346.81.
